row.proto: void Ne_Play_FullscreenVideo(void *feature_system, NeStr **path, const void *on_end, const void *frame_callbacks, int32_t layer)
row.notes: cxx=neon::NeUIGenericFeatureSystem::playFullscreenVideo (logs its pretty name on the UI channel: "<path> on VideoLayer <n>"). feature_system = (module+0x10)->vt[0xf0](module+0x10) with module = *(*(g_Game_Root+0xa0)+0x28) (FePopup_Dispatch_FeatureCmd 0x140266af0) or *(*(state+0xc88)+0x28) in session states; returns at once when its player (+0x108, NeUIFullScreenVideo) is null. Copies on_end {void (*fn)(void *ctx); void *ctx} to player+0xd0/+0xd8, shows the player (vt+0xd0(p,1,0)), sets the layer (0x14421c620), then 0x14421c750 posts the open: a path that does not start with "videos/" gets that prefix, Bink opens it relative to the game folder (onOpen 0x143f82d40: .bik plays as Bink 1 with the BT.601 limited-range matrix, .bk2 as Bink 2). The player update 0x14421dbf0 calls on_end.fn(ctx) when the video ends or is stopped. Session states use layer 4 (SessionStateIntroVideo 0x142d6d4c0 and the car-reveal feature command inline the same sequence); photo mode 0x142da2760 calls it out of line. frame_callbacks may be null.
